text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Comments that are suspected of constituting an official offence – e.g. discriminatory comments based on race, ethnicity, religion or sexual orientation, or comments that incite hatred or violence – may in addition be reported to the police.", "gist": "Offensive comments can be reported to the police."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Comments may be automatically checked and temporarily removed if we receive an exceptionally high number of postings.", "gist": "Comments may be auto-checked and removed during high posting volume."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "if their comments pose a particularly serious violation of the rules or if they post comments multiple times that fall under any of the above-mentioned criteria", "gist": "When a user's comments seriously violate rules or repeat prohibited content"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "We reserve the right to block users on any of our social media platforms for a maximum of two years", "gist": "The platform can block users for up to two years for serious rule violations"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "For questions about managing comments or blocking a user please write to:", "gist": "Contact address for comment management and user blocking inquiries"}]}
